When Croatian virologist Dr. Beata Halassy’s breast cancer returned for the third time, she made a bold decision: to experiment on herself using millions of viruses grown in her own lab. entry.title: Why Humanity Will Never Leave The Solar System

media:group.media:title: Why Humanity Will Never Leave The Solar System
media:group.media:description:
🌎 Get an exclusive 15% discount on Saily data plans! Use the code "kurzgesagt" at checkout. Download the Saily app or go to: https://saily.com/kurzgesagt ⛵
Watch the Universe ✨die✨. The LIMITED EDITION Vanishing Stars Pin just dropped on the kurzgesagt shop: https://shop.kgs.link/VanishingStars Only 10,000 exist, and each one is individually numbered. And it’s our first ever animated pin! Tilt it and witness the end of everything.
Sources & further reading: https://sites.google.com/view/sources-the-barrier/
After exploring most of Earth, venturing into space and exploring other planets, stars and galaxies seemed like an exciting, and even obvious next step. But the deeper we look, the more the universe reveals a hidden barrier between our Solar System and everything else around it. From the vast empty space, to the laws of physics themselves, there are many reasons why the dream of space travel might stay just a dream.
What is stopping us from reaching the stars? Why does space become more dangerous the faster you travel, and could even advanced alien civilizations be trapped around their home worlds?
